activeQuestion.prompt: Why should questions be sent before the visit?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 為何應在參訪前寄出問題？

options.whyZh: 寄問題用於安排工程師，與取消餐食無關。

options.text: So the factory can move the tour to May 10
options.zh: 以便將參訪改到五月十日
options.whyZh: 五月十日是收問題期限，參訪仍在十四日。

options.text: So relevant engineers can be invited
options.whyZh: 提前得知問題有助安排適當專業人員。

options.text: So visitors can receive permission to take photographs
options.whyZh: 生產區全面禁止攝影，寄問題不會改變此規定。

group.title: Factory visit arrangements
group.passage:
To: Project Orion visitors

Your factory tour is confirmed for May 14. Please arrive at the west reception at 9:15 a.m. and bring a photo ID. Visitors must wear closed-toe shoes; safety glasses will be supplied by the factory.

The tour covers incoming inspection, assembly, and final testing. The coating room is excluded because maintenance will be in progress. Photography is prohibited throughout the production area, but you may take notes.

A technical discussion will follow the tour in Meeting Room 2. Send your questions by May 10 so that we can invite the appropriate engineers. Lunch will be served at noon, and the visit will end at 1 p.m.
group.passageZh:
收件者：Orion 專案訪客

五月十四日的工廠參訪已確認。請於上午九點十五分抵達西側接待處，並攜帶附照片的身分證件。訪客須穿包覆腳趾的鞋子；工廠會提供護目鏡。

參訪包括進料檢驗、組裝及最終測試。塗佈室因進行維護，不列入參訪。整個生產區禁止攝影，但可以做筆記。

參訪後將在二號會議室進行技術討論。請最遲於五月十日寄來問題，以便我們邀請適當的工程師。中午供餐，參訪於下午一點結束。
